lines.text: Did you know? Fer is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means together plus carry?

words.ex: It can be inferred from the data that sales will continue to fall.
She is speaking at a conference in Seoul.

publish.title: Fer root: infer and conference
publish.value: Fer comes from Latin "ferre" (to carry, to bring). Words: infer and conference. infer = in + fer; conference = con + fer.
